The Eastern Ghats extend discontinuously through the northern districts of Andhra Pradesh. In Srikakulam district, these hill ranges are known as Mahendra Girulu (Mahendragiri Hills). These hills form part of the Eastern Ghats and extend into the neighbouring state of Odisha. Mahendragiri is associated with several historical and mythological traditions. According to the Ramayana, Sage Parasurama is believed to have performed penance here. The hills are also known for their rich biodiversity and ecological significance. The other hill ranges belong to different regions of Andhra Pradesh. Papi Kondalu are located along the Godavari River in the Alluri Sitarama Raju and Eluru regions, Palakondalu are mainly found in Kadapa district, while Nallamala Hills extend across Nandyal, Prakasam and neighbouring districts.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).

The Pithapuram Inscription of Velanati Prithvisvara, one of the rulers of the Velanati Chodas, mentions Kolleru Lake. The inscription provides valuable information about the geographical features, administration and political conditions of Coastal Andhra during the Velanati Choda period. Kolleru Lake, situated between the Krishna and Godavari deltas, has been an important freshwater lake since ancient times. It supported irrigation, agriculture, inland fisheries and local trade. Medieval inscriptions frequently mention the lake because of its economic and strategic importance. Today, Kolleru is recognized as one of the largest freshwater lakes in India and is a Ramsar Wetland Site.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
